writeChannel: Existing registered operational module connection, in memory, through the real repository only
controlChannel: Operator-supplied MySQL SELECT-only account via MembershipUsers
resourcePolicy: Preserve all existing rows and new fixtures, including complete staging. No delete/truncate or global rollback.
window: Avoid other imports modifying the observed operational/profile/permission tables during this integration window
context: Explicit repository fixture context; level existence and current import authority checked by SELECT, no HTTP or preflight dependency
rollback: Three failed confirmation checkpoints and one failed receipt checkpoint; rolled-back AUTO_INCREMENT allocations may leave gaps
